label: Juno Park, illustrator
html:
<style>
  @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Bricolage+Grotesque:opsz,wght@12..96,400;12..96,600;12..96,800&display=swap');
  #pf-playful {
    --background: oklch(0.985 0.014 95);
    --foreground: oklch(0.27 0.06 275);
    --card: oklch(1 0 0);
    --card-foreground: var(--foreground);
    --muted: oklch(0.95 0.02 300);
    --muted-foreground: oklch(0.48 0.05 275);
    --border: oklch(0.88 0.03 290);
    --input: var(--border);
    --primary: oklch(0.5 0.22 266);
    --primary-foreground: oklch(0.985 0.01 95);
    --secondary: oklch(0.93 0.05 350);
    --secondary-foreground: var(--foreground);
    --accent: oklch(0.93 0.13 98);
    --accent-foreground: var(--foreground);
    --ring: var(--primary);
    --chart-1: oklch(0.72 0.17 28);
    --chart-2: oklch(0.6 0.2 266);
    --chart-3: oklch(0.8 0.13 165);
    --chart-4: oklch(0.83 0.1 350);
    --chart-5: oklch(0.88 0.16 92);
    --radius: 1rem;
    --radius-sm: max(0px, calc(var(--radius) - 4px));
    --radius-md: max(0px, calc(var(--radius) - 2px));
    --radius-lg: var(--radius);
    --radius-xl: calc(var(--radius) + 4px);
    container: pf-playful / inline-size;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    width: 100%;
    overflow: clip;
    padding: 0 clamp(1rem, 4vw, 2.5rem) clamp(1rem, 3vw, 1.75rem);
    background: var(--background);
    color: var(--foreground);
    font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque', var(--font-sans);
  }
  /* one view at a time: the home view, or the story of a drawing */
  #pf-playful [hidden] {
    display: none !important;
  }
  .dark #pf-playful {
    --background: oklch(0.22 0.045 278);
    --foreground: oklch(0.96 0.02 95);
    --card: oklch(0.27 0.05 278);
    --muted: oklch(0.3 0.05 285);
    --muted-foreground: oklch(0.8 0.04 290);
    --border: oklch(0.38 0.05 285);
    --primary: oklch(0.78 0.14 266);
    --primary-foreground: oklch(0.2 0.05 278);
    --secondary: oklch(0.36 0.07 350);
    --accent: oklch(0.42 0.08 98);
  }
  #pf-playful .pf-page {
    max-width: 72rem;
    margin-inline: auto;
    padding-block: 0.5rem clamp(3rem, 7vw, 5rem);
  }
  #pf-playful .pf-home {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: clamp(3rem, 7vw, 5rem);
  }
  /* the header: the Site Header with a flower for a logo, pill links and the hello button */
  #pf-playful .pf-bar {
    background: transparent;
  }
  #pf-playful .pf-bar .mk-header-inner {
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 0.5rem 1.5rem;
    max-width: 72rem;
    padding-inline: 0;
  }
  #pf-playful .mk-header-brand {
    gap: 0.6rem;
    color: var(--foreground);
  }
  #pf-playful .pf-bar-mark {
    width: 2.25rem;
    aspect-ratio: 1;
    background: var(--chart-4);
    transition: rotate 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1);
  }
  #pf-playful .mk-header-brand:hover .pf-bar-mark {
    rotate: 45deg;
  }
  #pf-playful .mk-header-name {
    color: inherit;
    font-size: 1.375rem;
    font-weight: 800;
    letter-spacing: -0.04em;
  }
  #pf-playful .mk-header-nav {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 0.25rem;
    margin-inline-start: auto;
  }
  #pf-playful .mk-header-nav a {
    padding: 0.4rem 0.85rem;
    border-radius: 999px;
    color: inherit;
    font-size: 1rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    text-decoration: none;
    transition: rotate 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1);
  }
  #pf-playful .mk-header-nav a:hover {
    background: var(--accent);
    rotate: -3deg;
  }
  #pf-playful .mk-header-nav a[aria-current] {
    background: var(--secondary);
  }
  #pf-playful .mk-header-nav a:focus-visible {
    outline: 2px solid var(--ring);
    outline-offset: 2px;
  }
  @container pf-playful (max-width: 46rem) {
    #pf-playful .mk-header-nav {
      order: 3;
      gap: 0;
      width: 100%;
      margin-inline: -0.55rem 0;
    }
    #pf-playful .mk-header-nav a {
      padding-inline: 0.55rem;
    }
  }
  /* the story of a drawing: a tinted head with the picture, three cards, the client's words, two more frames */
  #pf-playful .pf-story {
    --pf-tint: color-mix(in oklch, var(--chart-4) 38%, var(--background));
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: clamp(2.5rem, 6vw, 4rem);
  }
  #pf-playful .pf-story[data-kind='mascot'] {
    --pf-tint: color-mix(in oklch, var(--chart-3) 38%, var(--background));
  }
  #pf-playful .pf-story[data-kind='pack'] {
    --pf-tint: color-mix(in oklch, var(--chart-5) 38%, var(--background));
  }
  #pf-playful .pf-story[data-kind='way'] {
    --pf-tint: color-mix(in oklch, var(--chart-2) 26%, var(--background));
  }
  #pf-playful .pf-story-top {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 0.75rem;
    margin-block-end: calc(clamp(2.5rem, 6vw, 4rem) * -0.5);
  }
  #pf-playful .pf-story-back {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.4rem;
    padding: 0.4rem 0.9rem;
    border: 2px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: var(--card);
    color: inherit;
    font-weight: 600;
    text-decoration: none;
    transition: rotate 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1);
  }
  #pf-playful .pf-story-back:hover {
    rotate: -2deg;
  }
  #pf-playful .pf-story-back svg {
    width: 1rem;
    height: 1rem;
  }
  #pf-playful .pf-story-count {
    font-weight: 600;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
  }
  #pf-playful .pf-story-head {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.2fr) minmax(0, 1fr);
    align-items: center;
    gap: 2.5rem;
    padding: clamp(1.75rem, 5vw, 3.5rem);
    border-radius: calc(var(--radius) * 2.5);
    background: var(--pf-tint);
  }
  #pf-playful .pf-story-head > div {
    display: grid;
    justify-items: start;
    gap: 1rem;
  }
  #pf-playful .pf-story-kind {
    padding: 0.2rem 0.8rem;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: var(--primary);
    color: var(--primary-foreground);
    font-size: 0.875rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    rotate: -3deg;
  }
  #pf-playful .pf-story-head h1 {
    margin: 0;
    font-size: clamp(2.5rem, 1.25rem + 4cqi, 4.25rem);
    font-weight: 800;
    line-height: 1;
    letter-spacing: -0.045em;
    text-wrap: balance;
  }
  #pf-playful .pf-story-meta {
    margin: 0;
    font-weight: 600;
  }
  #pf-playful .pf-story-lede {
    max-width: 32rem;
    margin: 0;
    font-size: 1.125rem;
    line-height: 1.5;
  }
  #pf-playful .pf-story-cover {
    position: relative;
    justify-self: center;
    width: min(100%, 24rem);
    margin: 0;
    rotate: 2deg;
  }
  #pf-playful .pf-story-cover img {
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
    aspect-ratio: 1;
    object-fit: cover;
    border: 0.6rem solid var(--card);
    border-radius: calc(var(--radius) * 1.25);
    box-shadow: 0.5rem 0.5rem 0 var(--foreground);
  }
  #pf-playful .pf-story-cover .pf-sticker {
    inset-block-start: -2rem;
    inset-inline-end: -1.5rem;
    width: 5.5rem;
    background: var(--chart-5);
    color: oklch(0.27 0.06 275);
    font-size: 1rem;
  }
  #pf-playful .pf-story-cards {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(15rem, 1fr));
    gap: 1.25rem;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    list-style: none;
  }
  #pf-playful .pf-story-cards li {
    display: grid;
    align-content: start;
    gap: 0.6rem;
    padding: 1.5rem;
    border: 2px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: calc(var(--radius) * 1.5);
    background: var(--card);
  }
  #pf-playful .pf-story-cards li:nth-child(odd) {
    rotate: -1deg;
  }
  #pf-playful .pf-story-cards li:nth-child(even) {
    rotate: 1deg;
  }
  #pf-playful .pf-story-cards h2 {
    margin: 0.25rem 0 0;
    font-size: 1.375rem;
    letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  }
  #pf-playful .pf-story-cards p {
    margin: 0;
    line-height: 1.6;
  }
  #pf-playful .pf-story-icon {
    display: grid;
    place-items: center;
    width: 3rem;
    aspect-ratio: 1;
    color: oklch(0.27 0.06 275);
  }
  #pf-playful .pf-story-icon svg {
    width: 1.25rem;
    height: 1.25rem;
  }
  #pf-playful .pf-story-more {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1fr);
    align-items: center;
    gap: clamp(1.25rem, 4vw, 2.5rem);
  }
  #pf-playful .pf-story-more .pf-word {
    grid-column: span 1;
  }
  #pf-playful .pf-story-frames {
    display: contents;
  }
  #pf-playful .pf-story-frames li {
    padding: 0.6rem 0.6rem 2rem;
    border: 2px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 0.5rem;
    background: var(--card);
    list-style: none;
    rotate: 2deg;
  }
  #pf-playful .pf-story-frames li:nth-child(even) {
    rotate: -3deg;
  }
  #pf-playful .pf-story-frames img {
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
    aspect-ratio: 4 / 3;
    object-fit: cover;
    border-radius: 0.25rem;
  }
  #pf-playful .pf-story-ask {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 1rem 1.5rem;
    padding: 1.75rem;
    border: 2px dashed var(--border);
    border-radius: calc(var(--radius) * 2);
    text-align: center;
  }
  #pf-playful .pf-story-ask p {
    margin: 0;
    font-size: 1.25rem;
    font-weight: 800;
    letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  }
  #pf-playful .mk-article-nav-title {
    font-weight: 800;
    letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  }
  @container pf-playful (max-width: 46rem) {
    #pf-playful .pf-story-head {
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
    }
    #pf-playful .pf-story-more {
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1fr);
    }
    #pf-playful .pf-story-more .pf-word {
      grid-column: 1 / -1;
    }
  }
  /* "Read the story": a link under each drawing in the viewer */
  #pf-playful .pf-viewer-story {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.35rem;
    margin-block-start: 0.6rem;
    padding: 0.35rem 0.9rem;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: oklch(0.93 0.13 98);
    color: oklch(0.27 0.06 275);
    font-weight: 700;
    text-decoration: none;
  }
  #pf-playful .pf-viewer-story:hover {
    background: oklch(0.88 0.16 92);
  }
  #pf-playful .pf-viewer-story:focus-visible {
    outline: 2px solid #fff;
    outline-offset: 2px;
  }
  #pf-playful .pf-viewer-story svg {
    width: 1rem;
    height: 1rem;
  }
  /* the footer: the Site Footer on a pink card, a sticker waving goodbye */
  #pf-playful .pf-foot {
    position: relative;
    max-width: 72rem;
    margin-inline: auto;
    border-radius: calc(var(--radius) * 2.5);
    background: var(--secondary);
    color: var(--secondary-foreground);
  }
  #pf-playful .pf-foot .mk-footer-inner {
    padding: clamp(2rem, 5vw, 3rem) clamp(1.5rem, 5vw, 3rem) 1.75rem;
  }
  #pf-playful .pf-foot .mk-footer-nav {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 8.5rem), 1fr));
    gap: 2rem 1rem;
  }
  #pf-playful .pf-foot .mk-footer-heading {
    color: inherit;
    font-size: 1.125rem;
    font-weight: 800;
    letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  }
  #pf-playful .pf-foot .mk-footer-list {
    gap: 0.5rem;
  }
  #pf-playful .pf-foot .mk-footer-list button {
    padding: 0;
    border: 0;
    background: none;
    color: inherit;
    font: inherit;
    text-align: start;
    cursor: pointer;
  }
  #pf-playful .pf-foot .mk-footer-list button:hover {
    text-decoration: underline;
    text-underline-offset: 3px;
  }
  #pf-playful .pf-foot .mk-footer-rule {
    border-color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground) 18%, transparent);
  }
  #pf-playful .pf-foot .mk-footer-bottom {
    flex-direction: row;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 1rem;
  }
  #pf-playful .pf-foot .mk-footer-brand {
    gap: 0.5rem;
    color: inherit;
  }
  #pf-playful .pf-foot .mk-footer-brand-name {
    font-size: 1.25rem;
    font-weight: 800;
    letter-spacing: -0.04em;
  }
  #pf-playful .pf-foot .mk-footer-copy {
    color: inherit;
  }
  #pf-playful .pf-foot > .pf-sticker {
    inset-block-start: -2.25rem;
    inset-inline-end: clamp(1rem, 6vw, 4rem);
    width: 5.5rem;
    background: var(--chart-5);
    color: oklch(0.27 0.06 275);
    font-size: 1rem;
  }
  @container pf-playful (max-width: 46rem) {
    #pf-playful .pf-foot > .pf-sticker {
      inset-block-start: -2.75rem;
      width: 4.5rem;
      font-size: 0.875rem;
    }
  }
  #pf-playful .pf-hero {
    position: relative;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.35fr) minmax(0, 1fr);
    align-items: center;
    gap: 2.5rem;
    padding: clamp(1.75rem, 5vw, 4rem);
    border-radius: calc(var(--radius) * 2.5);
    background-color: var(--secondary);
    overflow: clip;
    isolation: isolate;
  }
  #pf-playful .pf-hero.pattern-dots {
    --shape-ink: color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground) 14%, transparent);
  }
  #pf-playful .pf-blob {
    position: absolute;
    z-index: -1;
    width: clamp(12rem, 30cqi, 22rem);
    aspect-ratio: 1;
    opacity: 0.55;
    animation: pf-playful-wobble 9s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
  }
  @keyframes pf-playful-wobble {
    to {
      border-radius: 38% 62% 42% 58% / 60% 37% 63% 40%;
      rotate: 25deg;
      scale: 1.12;
    }
  }
  #pf-playful .pf-hi {
    margin: 0;
    font-size: 1.125rem;
    font-weight: 600;
  }
  #pf-playful .pf-hi span {
    display: inline-block;
    rotate: -8deg;
  }
  #pf-playful .pf-title {
    margin: 0;
    font-size: clamp(2.5rem, 1.25rem + 4.2cqi, 4.5rem);
    font-weight: 800;
    line-height: 1;
    letter-spacing: -0.045em;
  }
  #pf-playful .pf-title .text-rotate {
    display: block;
  }
  #pf-playful .pf-lede {
    max-width: 30rem;
    margin: 0;
    font-size: 1.125rem;
    line-height: 1.5;
  }
  #pf-playful .btn {
    border-radius: 999px;
  }
  #pf-playful .pf-portrait {
    position: relative;
    justify-self: center;
    width: min(100%, 22rem);
  }
  #pf-playful .pf-portrait img {
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
    aspect-ratio: 1;
    object-fit: cover;
  }
  #pf-playful .pf-sticker {
    position: absolute;
    inset-block-start: 0;
    inset-inline-end: 0;
    display: grid;
    place-items: center;
    width: 7rem;
    aspect-ratio: 1;
    background: var(--accent);
    color: var(--foreground);
    font-weight: 800;
    font-size: 1.0625rem;
    text-align: center;
    line-height: 1.05;
    animation: pf-playful-spin 16s linear infinite;
  }
  @keyframes pf-playful-spin {
    to {
      rotate: 360deg;
    }
  }
  #pf-playful h2 {
    margin: 0 0 1.75rem;
    font-size: clamp(2rem, 1rem + 3cqi, 3.25rem);
    font-weight: 800;
    letter-spacing: -0.04em;
  }
  #pf-playful h2 mark {
    padding-inline: 0.15em;
    border-radius: 0.3em;
    background: var(--accent);
    color: inherit;
  }
  #pf-playful .mk-portfolio-grid-title {
    font-family: inherit;
    font-style: normal;
    font-weight: 600;
  }
  #pf-playful .pf-shelf {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(9rem, 1fr));
    gap: 1.5rem;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    list-style: none;
    text-align: center;
  }
  #pf-playful .pf-shelf span {
    display: grid;
    place-items: center;
    width: min(100%, 9rem);
    aspect-ratio: 1;
    margin: 0 auto 0.75rem;
    color: var(--foreground);
    font-size: 2.5rem;
    transition:
      rotate 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1),
      scale 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1);
  }
  #pf-playful .pf-shelf li:hover span {
    rotate: -10deg;
    scale: 1.08;
  }
  #pf-playful .pf-shelf p {
    margin: 0;
    font-weight: 600;
  }
  #pf-playful .mk-availability[data-variant='spotlight'] {
    --primary: var(--chart-2);
    border-radius: calc(var(--radius) * 2.5);
  }
  #pf-playful .mk-availability.pattern-polka {
    --shape-ink: color-mix(in oklch, white 14%, transparent);
  }
  @container pf-playful (max-width: 46rem) {
    #pf-playful .pf-hero {
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
    }
  }
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    #pf-playful .pf-blob,
    #pf-playful .pf-sticker {
      animation: none;
    }
    #pf-playful .pf-shelf span {
      transition: none;
    }
  }
  /* the work: a filter over the pieces (radios; :has() hides the other kinds), each piece opens the viewer */
  #pf-playful .pf-filter {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    margin: -0.5rem 0 1.75rem;
  }
  #pf-playful .pf-filter label {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 0.4rem 0.9rem;
    border: 2px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: var(--card);
    font-weight: 600;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition:
      background 0.2s,
      rotate 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1);
  }
  #pf-playful .pf-filter label:hover {
    rotate: -2deg;
  }
  #pf-playful .pf-filter input {
    position: absolute;
    opacity: 0;
    pointer-events: none;
  }
  #pf-playful .pf-filter label:has(:checked) {
    border-color: var(--primary);
    background: var(--primary);
    color: var(--primary-foreground);
  }
  #pf-playful .pf-filter label:has(:focus-visible) {
    outline: 2px solid var(--ring);
    outline-offset: 2px;
  }
  #pf-playful:has(.pf-filter [value='book']:checked) .mk-portfolio-grid-item:not([data-kind='book']),
  #pf-playful:has(.pf-filter [value='mascot']:checked) .mk-portfolio-grid-item:not([data-kind='mascot']),
  #pf-playful:has(.pf-filter [value='pack']:checked) .mk-portfolio-grid-item:not([data-kind='pack']),
  #pf-playful:has(.pf-filter [value='way']:checked) .mk-portfolio-grid-item:not([data-kind='way']) {
    display: none;
  }
  #pf-playful button.mk-portfolio-grid-link {
    width: 100%;
    padding: 0;
    border: 0;
    background: none;
    color: inherit;
    font: inherit;
    text-align: inherit;
    cursor: zoom-in;
  }
  #pf-playful .pf-viewer .mk-media-gallery-track p {
    max-width: 40rem;
    margin-inline: auto;
    line-height: 1.5;
  }
  #pf-playful .pf-viewer::backdrop {
    background: oklch(0.08 0.01 260 / 0.94);
    backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
  }
  #pf-playful .pf-viewer strong {
    color: #fff;
  }
  #pf-playful .pf-viewer-steps {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 1rem;
  }
  #pf-playful .pf-viewer-step {
    display: grid;
    place-items: center;
    width: 2.75rem;
    height: 2.75rem;
    border: 0;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: oklch(1 0 0 / 0.15);
    color: #fff;
    cursor: pointer;
  }
  #pf-playful .pf-viewer-step:hover {
    background: oklch(1 0 0 / 0.28);
  }
  #pf-playful .pf-viewer-step:focus-visible {
    outline: 2px solid #fff;
    outline-offset: 2px;
  }
  /* how a drawing happens: four cards, a numbered blob on each */
  #pf-playful .pf-steps {
